_readme: LLM eval fixture set for the job-post analyzer. Each case: raw post text (realistic Taglish, synthetic — no real agency names among scams), expected extraction fields, expected red flags, expected post-level verdict (registry lookup verdict is layered separately). Run in CI on any prompt change. Add real-world cases from DMW advisories over time. EVAL METRIC (2026-07-25): the CI gate is verdict-level — run each extraction through the real verdict engine and compare the computed post verdict to expect.verdict; pass bar is >=90% of fixtures (18/20), temperature 0, one run each. Flag-level precision/recall, extraction-field accuracy, and the evidence_quote substring check are reported as diagnostics but do not gate.

scam.text: HIRING!! Factory workers for JAPAN 🇯🇵 Salary ¥300,000/month!! No experience needed, no age limit! Processing fee lang na ₱15,000 para sa medical at training. Slots limited!! DM na for reservation. GCash accepted.

Direct hire po sa Dubai, waitress position, AED 2500/month + tips + free accommodation. Tourist visa muna kayo tapos i-convert na lang po pagdating. Walang placement fee, salary deduction na lang for 3 months. Contact Ms. Jenny on WhatsApp +971-XX-XXX.

URGENT HIRING: Customer Service Representatives for CAMBODIA. Basic English lang kailangan! $1,000-$1,500/month, free flight, free visa, free food & lodging. Online gaming company. 18-35 years old. Send CV via Telegram @jobsasia_recruit. Departure next week!

Legit agency po kami! Licensed by DMW (License No. DMW-2026-ABC-99999-XYZ). Hiring caregivers for Canada, CAD $25/hour. Application fee ₱5,000 non-refundable. Office: online lang muna, magme-meet tayo sa coffee shop for requirements.

POLAND FACTORY WORKERS!! 100 slots!! €1,800/month guaranteed overtime. Walang edad limit, kahit walang passport pwede — kami na bahala. Downpayment ₱25,000, balance salary deduction. Legit po ito, may kakilala kami sa embassy.

Au pair sa Denmark, ₱90,000/month!! Ako po ay nakapag-abroad na, tutulungan ko kayo. Send ₱3,500 for document processing sa GCash number ko. May group chat kami ng mga successful applicants, add ko kayo after payment.

SEAFARERS WANTED — cruise ship USA, $2,800/month, kahit walang experience o seaman's book, kami mag-aayos ng documents. Interview via Messenger video call lang. Reservation fee $100 through Western Union para ma-hold ang slot mo.

Hiring hotel staff for Qatar under ABC International Manpower Services (DMW licensed daw po sabi ng contact ko). Direct kayo makakausap ng owner. ₱8,000 for medical schedule tapos may briefing na. Room attendant QAR 1,600 + OT. Hurry, until Friday lang!

expect.note: agency name present — registry lookup layer decides if it exists; post-level flags alone already HIGH_RISK

scam.text: IT support / encoder needed in Myanmar-Thailand border area, $1,200/month cash. Typing skills lang! Free everything. Kaya mo yan kahit fresh grad. PM for details, sasabihin namin travel route (via Bangkok). Passport lang dala mo.

Caregiver Israel — may partner kaming lending company para sa placement fee mo (₱120,000, installment). Sign lang ng promissory note at ATM card as collateral. Salary $1,500/month. Legit agency po, luma na kami sa industry.

NOT A RECRUITMENT AGENCY po kami, visa assistance lang! Canada working visa 100% approval, ₱180,000 package inclusive na lahat. May mga na-deploy na kami, check niyo testimonials sa page namin. Message for free assessment!
Hiring domestic helpers for Hong Kong under license POEA-000-LB-000000-R. HK$4,870/month. Training fee ₱12,000 kasama na ang TESDA certificate (kami na bahala kahit hindi ka pumasok sa training).

expect.note: domestic workers must be no-placement-fee; any fee = violation

scam.text: CONGRATS sa 47 deployed namin this month!! 🎉🎉 (photos of airport send-offs) Korea factory E-9 visa, ₩2.1M/month. Slots for December batch open na. Reserve with ₱10,000 (deductible sa total fee na ₱250,000). Legit to, may TIN at business permit kami.

expect.note: Korea E-9 goes through government-to-government EPS only — no private agency can deploy; encode as deterministic rule

scam.text: Talent scouts looking for models/entertainers for Japan clubs, ¥400,000/month, 18-25 female only. No talent visa needed daw, may ibang route kami. Audition sa private residence sa QC this Saturday. Bring 2x2 photos and ₱2,000 audition fee.

OFFICIAL POST from [REAL-AGENCY-NAME] — hiring nurses for UK, £2,400/month. Note: bagong Facebook page po ito, yung luma ay na-hack. Requirements fee ₱7,500 sa bagong GCash ng liaison namin si Sir Mark 09XX-XXX-XXXX. Wag na po tumawag sa landline, busy lagi.

expect.note: Critical case: agency EXISTS and is VALID in registry, but the post is an impersonation. Post-level flags must override the registry ✅. Verdict = worst-of rule.

legit.text: JOB ORDER: Household Service Workers for Saudi Arabia. Zero placement fee po (as per policy for HSWs). Salary SR 1,500/month. Apply personally at our office: Unit 502, ___ Building, Ermita, Manila, Mon-Fri 8AM-5PM. Bring passport, PEOS certificate. XYZ International Placement Agency Inc., DMW License No. DMW-072-LB-09262023-UL (validity until 2027).

expect.note: valid license format, physical office, no fees, PEOS mentioned — final verdict depends on registry lookup

legit.text: Now hiring: Able Seaman for bulk carrier, 9-month contract, USD 780/month basic + OT per CBA. Principal: ___ Shipping Co. Ltd. Apply at our Intramuros office with SIRB, COCs, and updated SRC. ABC Crew Management Phils., POEA-045-SB-112119-R. Walk-in applicants processed Tue/Thu.

Factory operators for Taiwan (electronics). NT$28,590/month basic per Taiwan labor standards. Placement fee per DMW schedule, receipts issued. Requirements: passport, NBI, medical at DOH-accredited clinic. Interview at our Makati office next week — bring printed resume. DEF Manpower Services Inc., DMW-101-LB-03152024-UL.

expect.note: realistic salary matching Taiwan's actual minimum, official fee schedule cited, receipts, accredited clinic

legit.text: URGENT: 10 welders (6G) for Bahrain, BD 220/month + food allowance. Must have NCII and 2 yrs experience. Final interview with employer on Feb 3 at DMW-registered office in Malate. GHI International Services, license DMW-033-LB-07182023-UL. No fees collected until job order confirmed; placement fee not to exceed one month salary per POEA rules.

expect.note: 'URGENT' alone is not a red flag when everything else checks out — urgency must combine with fees/anonymity to flag

legit.text: PSA sa mga kababayan: bago mag-apply abroad, i-verify muna ang agency sa DMW website. Punta sa dmw.gov.ph > Licensed Recruitment Agencies. Wag magbayad ng kahit ano bago makita ang job order. Share niyo po ito.

expect.note: analyzer must recognize non-job-post content and say so, not force a verdict
